profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 19 years of Microsoft experience, especially in the test discipline. Experienced engineering leader with a strong understanding of the product life-cycle and software development. Throughout my career, I have worked on and managed high performing teams across client, server, services and most recently mobile devices that are used by millions of people. I have worked on successful v1’s and established businesses that are core to Microsoft. I am passionate about building great products and teams with a focus on quality and customers. I have a proven ability to influence without authority while working positively with colleagues across all levels of the organization on new ideas and strategies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Automation driver of test automation for Microsoft Sway, a team of 50 engineers.
•	Responsible for automation suite quality, reporting, investigation, and execution
•	Transitioned automation suite from a test-team centric model to combined engineering, decentralized ownership agile model
•	Drove a cross-product automation virtual team

•	Created new automation infrastructure for in-proc automation in Sway’s C++ rich-client application

•	Performed a variety of UI polish work for Sway authoring using JavaScript and TypeScript
•	Filled a backlog of unit tests for Sway authoring features
•	Created new authoring feature for SubHeadings requiring logic changes on client and server

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Performed manual testing on new CoAuthoring feature on the Word Web Application Companion.
•	Created initial automation and infrastructure to test new CoAuthoring feature within existing infrastructure.

•	Created new automation infrastructure, libraries, and initial automation scripts for a new Office Win32 Client application.
•	Automation driver for the new Office application.
•	Performed manual testing on feature involving parsing and displaying of arbitrary web pages in client application

positions.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Accepted a temporary assignment to Beijing, China to skill-share with engineers in Beijing
•	Gave a presentation on being a senior Test Engineer in Microsoft
•	Worked remotely with Redmond on the Microsoft WAC CoAuthoring feature
•	Joined management meetings and offsite trips to represent Senior Engineers

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Assumed automation driver for Word’s automation suite. Over 8000 test scripts in a variety of automation infrastructures.
•	Adapted automation suite to a single automation infrastructure and retired unnecessary scripts
•	Drove an automation investigation team, code coverage reporting, and API coverage.
•	Drop test passes and coverage automation pushes across the test team
•	Performed testing and automating on numerous non-English languages
•	Owned the testing of a variety of features including (but not limited to), Programmability, Macros, Document Protection, Building Blocks, Custom XML, Smart Tags, Smart Documents, Tables, Chained Undo.
•	Performed manual testing and manual test passes on a variety of features in Microsoft Word
•	Create and review test plans for all features
•	Primary test driver for CoAuthoring, a multi-engineer, multi-client/server collaboration feature crossing product boundaries.
•	Mentored incoming interns and participated in interview loops.
•	Create and review DOC file format compliance documents to adhere to European legal requirements

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Owned the testing of a variety of features including web pages, web APIs, command-line executables, client-side app, setup
•	Performed manual testing and executed manual test passes
•	Created, maintained, debugged, and executed test automation
•	Created and reviewed test plans and test pass proposals
•	Performed testing and automating on numerous non-English languages
•	Performed feature-level triage to drive features to ship
•	Attended suite-level triage to champion product fixes and security patches
•	Assumed numerous driver roles including automation, security, world readiness, Y2K compliance
•	Mentored incoming new hires and participated in interview loops

positions.title: Intern Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Intern tester working on Microsoft Windows Handheld devices, the first devices to use Windows CE operating system.

•	Performed manual testing and executed manual test passes
•	Created and reviewed test plans and test pass proposals
•	Owned setup program for Windows desktop syncing software

positions.description:

Working with confidential information

patents.title: Techniques for minimum permissions detection and verification
patents.description: Under automated testing, dynamically determines the minimum permissions necessary for a specific operation. Minimum permissions are saved as a baseline and future tests, validate the permissions in automation.
